portability.pageIntro: Bring your audience along: share a follow link and count who follows through it, tell viewers who asked where you moved, and take your channel's setup with you in a bundle.
portability.loadFailed: Your move settings could not be loaded.
portability.links.title: Follow links
portability.links.intro: Pin a link wherever your audience is now. Each follow made through it is counted; follows our integrity checks exclude are not.
portability.links.createFailed: The link could not be created.
portability.links.tooManyActive: You have 10 active links. Revoke one to create another.
portability.links.tooManyToday: You created 20 links today. Try again tomorrow.
portability.links.newHint: Copy it now: for your safety it is shown only once.
portability.links.copyFailed: The link could not be copied.
portability.links.emptyHint: Create a link and share it with the audience you are bringing along.
portability.links.conversions: {count, plural, =0 {No follows yet} one {# follow} other {# follows}}
portability.links.revokeBody: People who open it can still follow you, but their follows will no longer be counted for this link. This cannot be undone.
portability.links.revokeFailed: The link could not be revoked.
portability.moved.title: Moved to
portability.moved.intro: Say where your channel lives now. Your channel page shows the address, and viewers who asked to be told get one email. You never see who they are.
portability.moved.subscriptions: Moving does not end, pause or refund subscriptions: they continue until you end them.
portability.moved.current: Your channel page says you moved to
portability.moved.urlHint: An https address, up to 500 characters, without a user name or password.
portability.moved.invalid: Enter an https address without a user name or password.
portability.moved.confirmBody: Your channel page will point to {url}, and everyone who asked to be told gets one email now. You cannot unsend it.
portability.moved.saveFailed: The move could not be saved.
portability.moved.clearBody: Your channel page stops showing the address. No email is sent.
portability.export.title: Export your channel
portability.export.intro: Download a bundle with your channel's title, description, tags, panels and emotes, and a signed statement of your channel's standing here, to import on another instance. We email you a link when it is ready.
portability.export.requested: Export requested. We will email you when it is ready.
portability.export.cooldown: You exported recently. Try again later.
portability.export.failed: The export could not be requested.
portability.import.title: Import a bundle
portability.import.intro: Bring your setup from another instance. Every image is checked as a new upload is, nothing is applied until you choose, and your existing mature label is never removed.
portability.import.fileHint: A .zip bundle exported from an instance.
portability.import.uploadFailed: The bundle could not be uploaded.
portability.import.pending: Still checking the bundle. This page updates when it is done.
portability.import.assert: I have the right to use the art of the emotes I chose on this instance.
portability.import.assertNeeded: Confirm you have the right to use the emote art first.
portability.import.startFailed: The import could not be started.
portability.import.standing.unverifiedHi: This bundle has no valid signed statement of the channel's standing where it came from. You can still import it.
portability.reason.codeTaken: You already have an emote with this code
portability.reason.emoteLimit: You have reached the emote limit
portability.reason.unsupportedType: This image type is not supported here
portability.reason.missingFile: The image is missing from the bundle
portability.reason.invalidCode: The emote code is not valid
portability.reason.carriedNotApplied: Kept in the bundle, not applied: there is no schedule here yet
portability.reason.standingSuspended: The channel is suspended where it came from, so it cannot be imported.
portability.reason.standingLegalHold: The channel is under a legal hold where it came from, so it cannot be imported.
portability.reason.importerLegalHold: Your account cannot import a bundle right now.
portability.reason.channelSuspended: Your channel is suspended, so it cannot import a bundle.
portability.reason.archiveMissing: The uploaded bundle is gone. Upload it again.
portability.reason.archiveChanged: The bundle changed after its preview. Upload it again.
portability.reason.previewFailed: The bundle could not be checked. Upload it again.
portability.reason.nothingToApply: Nothing to change: the chosen fields already match or have no match here.
portability.reason.badBundle: This file is not a bundle this instance can read.
portability.landing.loadFailed: This link could not be opened.
portability.landing.intro: {channel} shared this link so you can follow them here.
portability.landing.goneHint: You can still find the channel and follow it from its page.
portability.grants.title: Tell me if they move
portability.grants.intro: For each channel you follow, choose whether we may email you once if it moves elsewhere. The streamer never sees who asked, and we delete your request after that one email.
portability.grants.loadFailed: Your channels could not be loaded.
portability.grants.empty: You do not follow any channels yet
portability.grants.emptyHint: Follow a channel, then come back to choose whether to hear if it moves.
portability.grants.saveFailed: Your choice could not be saved.
portability.notice.title: {channel} has moved
portability.notice.external: This address leaves this instance; the streamer chose it.
portability.notice.subscriptions: Subscriptions continue until the streamer ends them.
